counterfactual_conversion.claim_boundary: Calibrated counterfactual conversion from simulated UST redemption demand to gross LUNA mint. It is an approximation fitted to historical native swap outputs, not a protocol accounting identity.
limitations: Hourly market price is used as a conversion reference and does not reproduce every on-chain curve state.
The multiplier is fixed before the validation window and is not re-estimated inside a stress path.
No future observed issuance, price, withdrawal, liquidity, or reserve flow enters a simulated path.
counterfactual_conversion.name: COUNTERFACTUAL_REDEMPTION_TO_LUNA_APPROXIMATION

data_policy.conversion: Calibrated historical approximation used only to parameterize an endogenous counterfactual mapping; not a protocol identity.
data_policy.dex_liquidity: Scenario assumption, not observed historical Terra DEX depth.
data_policy.future_observations: No future observed price, supply, withdrawal, liquidity, reserve, or issuance value is used.
data_policy.reserve_intervention: Scenario assumption; audited LFG peg-defense flow is unavailable.

not_reused.supply_realization: Historical net-supply calibration is not treated as a future gross-mint identity; stress mint uses the separately calibrated counterfactual conversion.

reused.luna_dilution_elasticity: Maps endogenous supply dilution into LUNA price pressure.
reused.mint_ust_impact: Feeds simulated LUNA dilution pressure back into the UST gap.
reused.peg_recovery: Scales recovery supplied by executable arbitrage.
reused.withdrawal_price_impact: Scales market impact from net UST sell pressure.
reused.withdrawal_sell_fraction: Maps simulated Anchor withdrawals into UST sell pressure.
